rounds.response:
Recommend these concise bidding guidelines: price bands — inspections/small call‑offs: cost +12–15%; recurring frameworks/medium maintenance: cost +11–13%; major overhauls/retrofits: cost +15–18% (spare‑parts supply default ~12% where volumes permit).  
Warranty/SLAs — default warranty at the midpoint of the tender’s allowed range (extend only for an incremental premium of ≥2–4% on high‑risk equipment); response times default to emergency 4 hrs, priority 24 hrs, routine 5 business days, and reports within 48 hrs.  
Capacity thresholds — only submit if projected peak‑month utilization after award stays ≤80% (allow small ad‑hoc work up to +10% capacity); accept at most one additional medium or one additional large project beyond current commitments.  
Walk‑away rules — decline opportunities that force us to bid below cost +10% margin, require unsafe compression of outage/delivery without premium, or would push peak utilization above 90%.  
Approvals/process — require joint sign‑off from Ops and Finance for any exceptions, document cost baselines and margin rationale in each submission, and strictly obey compliance rules (no competitor communications).
